findings.claim: The change classifies MsgPack017 as source-generation-only and suppresses it for types using dynamic serialization, but MsgPack017 describes a runtime deserialization hazard: an init property initializer is replaced by the type's default value. That hazard still applies when no formatter is generated, so suppressed types lose a relevant contract warning and the README gives users incorrect guidance.

receipt_plan.detail: Add an analyzer test for [MessagePackObject(SuppressSourceGeneration = true)] with a [Key] init property that has an initializer and expect MsgPack017. This follows the runtime behavior recorded in [L6] and doc/analyzers/MsgPack017.md; the current SourceGenerationOnlyDiagnosticsAreNotReportedWhenSuppressed test instead locks in the missing warning.
